method: Explicit HTTP range reads from public GitHub release ZIPs; each extracted member verified against committed source manifest size and SHA256. Whole ZIP SHA256 was NOT locally recomputed by this control audit; archive_remote_digest is publisher metadata. Root independently downloaded and verified complete ZIPs containing both trajectories.
source_reconstruction: r25-source snapshot, reverse r25 to r24; apply r26,r27,r28,r29,r29-qp1,r29-qp2,r30,r31,r32,r33,r34. All patch applications exit0. Read-only scratch reconstruction, no build, simulator or runtime edit.
reconstructed_source_hash_checks_note: Initial reconstruction matched18/22. The four mismatches were then fetched from published actual source; every replacement matches the build.json SHA256. See actual_source_originals.
actual_source_difference_interpretation: Three prior hash differences were CRLF-versus-LF only (normalized text identical). r29_projection.h actual source additionally retains a repeated older definition after the complete guarded current implementation, protected by the identical already-defined include guard; it is not compiled. Current full actual file was fetched and matches recorded build SHA256.
